title: Style-Library Contribution (divergent-inspector → OODS Foundry)
description: Draft. The inbound format divergent-inspector uses to send a measured style fingerprint back to OODS Foundry: the counterpart to the s123 OODS Foundry-owned style-library-artifact.schema.json (the key→var skin map). This is a distinct artifact with a distinct name — the artifact is the mapping OODS Foundry owns; this is the contribution a consumer sends in. NO runtime ingestion loader/validator exists yet: per the s123 'lock the pipe at n=8 first' posture, ingestion is deferred until the format is ratified. Skip-listed from generated.ts (NON_SCHEMA_DATA_FILES in schemas-tools/generate-types.ts) so this draft never emits a type for an unratified format — generated.ts stays byte-identical; the file still bundles to dist/ via the package.json wildcard cp. Three blocks: (1) brand_apply — a measured DTCG delta shaped like brand_apply.input.json so it can round-trip through the live apply path; (2) confidence — per-path confidence + evidence gates; (3) signatures — measured surface fingerprints shaped like the component_map action=create projection_variant. Root is intentionally permissive (no required block) for the co-author pass — see open question (a).

schemaVersion.description: Contribution format version, independent of the style-library-artifact schemaVersion. Carries a draft tag while the format is unratified.

source.description: Provenance of the contribution. Proposed answer to open question (d) [collision/re-run disambiguation]: run_id + measured_at disambiguate two runs that return the same signature id+surface+selector. Flagged for co-author sanity-check.

run_id.description: Stable id of the measurement run — the re-run disambiguator.

brand_apply.description: Measured token delta, shaped to drop into brand_apply (mirrors brand_apply.input.json so a contribution can round-trip the live apply path). Open question (a): one brand+delta per invocation (what brand_apply takes today) vs a batch (array of these) when divergent measures many surfaces in one run — root is left permissive pending this call. Open question (c): does divergent's measured delta match brand_apply's delta exactly — object-only (alias) here, or must OODS Foundry also accept the RFC-6902 patch-array form plus a normalization step?

brand.description: Target brand identifier: a brand in the brand registry (the brands folder the token build reads). Left as a free string so the contribution format does not pin a brand list.

strategy.description: alias = DTCG dot-path→value object; patch = RFC-6902 ops. Brand_apply gates the delta shape on this exact enum.

delta.description: Measured token changes. alias form = a map of DTCG dot-path (e.g. 'color.surface.default') to value; patch form = RFC-6902 ops. Matches brand_apply.input.json's delta oneOf so it round-trips.

oneOf.description: alias strategy: DTCG dot-path → measured value.

confidence.description: Per-path measurement confidence + evidence, keyed by the same DTCG dot-path used in brand_apply.delta (alias form). Lets OODS Foundry gate which measured deltas it trusts before they reach the skin. Record<path, {confidence, evidence}>.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the measured value (selector hits, sample counts, screenshot refs, …).

signatures.description: Measured surface fingerprints, each shaped like a component_map action=create projection_variant (id, surface, external_component?, capability_id?, selector?, confidence?, evidence_chain?, metadata). metadata is additionalProperties:true and load-bearing — it carries the measured fingerprint payload. Open question (b): which of these fields does divergent actually populate? external_component / capability_id / selector are all optional in the live projection_variant shape.

id.description: Stable identifier for the measured signature.

surface.description: Surface label such as desktop, mobile, modal, or sidebar.

external_component.description: Surface-specific component label when it differs from the canonical name (optional).

capability_id.description: Optional first-class capability entity linked to this signature.

metadata.description: Load-bearing open bag — carries the measured style fingerprint payload (the reason this block is shaped like projection_variant).
